sections.heading: 1. Controller
sections.body: Sebastian Kehle, Eva-Laube-Weg 5, 14473 Potsdam, Germany. Email: mail@webvise.io.

sections.heading: 2. Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect the following data when you use our website:
items: Contact form submissions (name, email, company, message): to respond to your inquiry.

Usage analytics (page views, referrer, device type): to improve our website. We use PostHog, which can be configured to anonymize IP addresses. PostHog usage analytics run only after you accept analytics in the cookie banner.
Performance analytics (page load times, web vitals, navigation paths): to monitor site performance. We use Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights, which collect anonymized data without cookies.
Error tracking data (browser, OS, stack traces): to fix bugs. PostHog collects these error reports together with usage analytics, and only after you accept analytics in the cookie banner.

AI chat messages and chat analytics: when you use our chat widget, your messages are sent to Google Gemini via Vercel AI Gateway for processing. Messages are not stored beyond the active browser session. If you accepted analytics cookies, the widget also sends your PostHog distinct ID to the server so we can record a PostHog event with message count and whether a user message was present. Message content is not sent to PostHog.
WP Health Report: when you use this tool, the URL you provide is sent to the Google PageSpeed Insights API for performance analysis. No personal data is transmitted.

Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID: G-D5466MRK51): page views, session data, and device information to measure site performance and ad campaign effectiveness. Only collected after you grant consent via the cookie banner. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent).
Google Ads conversion tracking: conversion events to measure ad campaign effectiveness. Only active after consent is granted.

sections.heading: 3. Legal Basis
sections.body: We process your data based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract performance) for contact form submissions, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest) for performance monitoring with Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent) for PostHog analytics and error reports, AI chat interactions, consent-gated chat analytics, and Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads tracking. You can withdraw consent at any time via the cookie banner (see section 10).

sections.heading: 4. Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your data. We share data only with processors who act on our behalf:
items: Vercel (hosting, analytics, speed insights, AI gateway): USA, GDPR-compliant
Google (Gemini AI for chat, PageSpeed Insights, Analytics 4, Ads conversion tracking): USA, GDPR-compliant

sections.heading: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: Contact form data is retained for 12 months after your last interaction, then deleted. Analytics data, including consent-gated chat analytics events, is retained for 24 months. AI chat messages are not persisted beyond the active browser session. You can request deletion at any time.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, and objection. To exercise these rights, email us at mail@webvise.io.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and Tracking (Consent Mode v2)
sections.body: Google's tags load only after you accept via the cookie banner. Before that, no Google script runs and nothing is sent to Google. When you accept, Google Analytics 4 (G-D5466MRK51), Google Ads conversion tracking, and PostHog analytics become active. You can withdraw consent at any time (see section 10). Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights operate without cookies regardless of consent. PostHog analytics is cookie-free where possible.

sections.heading: 8. External Links
sections.body: The booking page (/book) embeds a Cal.com calendar. When it is shown, your browser loads it from Cal.com, which receives your IP address and browser details. Name, email and notes you enter in the booking form are passed to Cal.com to fill in the booking. Other links to external services lead off our website, where the provider's privacy policy applies.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.

sections.heading: 10. Withdrawing Consent
sections.body: You can withdraw your cookie consent at any time by clicking "Cookie Preferences" in the footer. This clears your stored choice and the analytics identifiers that PostHog and Google Analytics stored in your browser, then shows the consent banner again, allowing you to change your selection. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing that occurred before withdrawal. GA4 data already collected is retained for up to 14 months per Google's standard retention setting.
